title: Appeal

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello Husslers,

After reviewing your previous appeals, it is clear that you have waited long enough as a banned user. However, I recall much irresponsibility and rudeness in your last weeks before your ban. If you continue to break rules like such, you will be banned permanently and will not have a chance to appeal again. Please make sure to read the updated rules (http://avicus.net/rules), and welcome back to the server. Your appeal is accepted.

Regards,
Rinn | Senior Moderator
